what_it_is.prose: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) is an Indian multinational EPC and hi-tech manufacturing conglomerate, founded on 7 February 1946 in Mumbai. Its defence arm — operating through L&T Precision Engineering & Systems Ltd (LTPES) and L&T Defence — is one of India's largest private-sector defence manufacturers. Land systems flagship: K9 Vajra-T 155mm/52 calibre tracked self-propelled howitzer (license-built with South Korea's Hanwha Aerospace) — original ₹4,500 Cr contract for 100 units (2017); second ₹7,629 Cr contract signed 23 December 2024 for ~100 additional units; Indian Army planning 300 more K9 Vajra-T (~$2.75B / ₹23,000 Cr) reported June 2026, which would push fleet past 500 systems. L&T is the largest supplier of missile canisters to BrahMos Aerospace and manufactures 50-100 missile launchers per year for Pinaka and MR-SAM programmes; developed the Quadruple Canisterized Inclined Launcher (Quad Launcher) for BrahMos missiles on Indian Navy surface warships (announced May 2018). At Hazira, L&T constructs submarine hulls (including for Arihant-class SSBN programme) and special alloy forgings for defence applications. In naval programmes, L&T entered a teaming agreement with Spain's Navantia for Project-75(I) submarine programme (July 2023, project value >€4.8B) — but the L&T-Navantia bid was eliminated in January 2025 for not meeting Indian Navy technical parameters, with Mazagon Dock-ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) emerging as sole compliant bidder.
